# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting HAL-C2 through
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/hal-c2/hal-c2/security/advisories/new)
on `hal-c2/hal-c2`. Please do not disclose them publicly until we have had a reasonable opportunity
to investigate and remediate them.

HAL-C2 is a fork of [T3 Code](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code). If a vulnerability also affects
T3 Code, report it to upstream as well, following upstream's security policy.
